confidence_note: ECE and reliability use the top-1 probability; coverage uses the response confidence field (1 - H/ln K for choice and score, max(p, 1 - p) for noul).

calibration.fit_on: the first 4500 interactions of runs/v3_log_s0/log.jsonl (N 5000), Bernoulli log-likelihood of the logged outcomes of the chosen actions, under the learner's probabilities from runs/v3_06b_direct_brier_n5000_s0_prefix

source_fields_note: latency, batching_precision, precision, data_files_sha256, device and wall_clock_seconds are the source run's; a temperature does not change them
